title: Late-Fee History and the ClearPath Renewal Rate
content:
The payment-standing adjustment of the renewal rate on an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement counts the late fees posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today) and adds a percentage to the renewal rate.

| Late fees posted in the window | Added to the renewal rate |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.0 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 0.5 percent |
| none | nothing |

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. The late fees counted are the late fee entries on the agreement's billing ledger, by posting date.

**Hypothetical cases (today 2025-09-01).** Late fees posted 2024-10-01, 2025-02-01 and 2025-05-01: three in the window, 1.0 percent added. Late fees posted 2024-09-01 and 2025-03-01: the first is 12 whole months old and outside the window, leaving one, so 0.5 percent is added. No late fee since 2024-08-01: nothing is added.
